description: This file defines syntax highlighting rules for Dockerfile syntax in a code editor, specifically using CodeMirror's mode definitions. It sets regex patterns for Dockerfile directives like FROM, EXPOSE, and others, and specifies how different parts of Dockerfile syntax are tokenized for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a simple syntax highlighting mode for Dockerfiles in CodeMirror.

methods.name: defineMIME
methods.description: Associates the 'text/x-dockerfile' MIME type with the 'dockerfile' mode.
